spans.text: And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord.
So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

folded.id: that they|will|have gardens [in paradise] beneath which rivers flow
folded.subject: that they
folded.object: have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow

spans.text: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow.
And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.
And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it.
And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers.

folded.id: their example|is|that of one who kindled a fire
folded.subject: Their example
folded.object: that of one who kindled a fire

spans.text: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.
In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.
Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil.
Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance.
Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.

folded.id: then he|showed|them to the angels and said
folded.subject: Then He
folded.object: them to the angels and said

spans.text: Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.
Then will you not reason?
And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.
Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before."

folded.id: this|is|the book about which there is no doubt
folded.subject: This
folded.object: the Book about which there is no doubt

spans.text: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah - Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them, And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

folded.id: this|is|what we were provided with before
folded.subject: This
folded.object: what we were provided with before

spans.text: Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before."
Guide us to the straight path - The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

folded.id: those|are|the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance
folded.subject: Those
folded.object: the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance

spans.text: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?"

folded.subject: when they

spans.text: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before."
And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees.
But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning.
They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us.
And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority."
